summary: As a pre-trial design, Advanced is plausible. A solver must infer how duplicate identity, persisted financial effects, capacity, clearing, ledger recognition, reconciliation and close interact. Plausible local repairs can remain globally wrong. This is a design verdict only; measured difficulty remains unproven until agent trials run.

evidence.observation: Broad restart branches make ALREADY_* states look like new execution while finalization can still publish/complete from inconsistent state.
Starter persistence layer does not itself enforce one financial effect, so solver must reason about DB and controller together.
Scenarios probe clean, completed rerun, partial internal/external restart, reconciliation hold, eligibility, pending history, and close gates.

do_not_change: Do not harden with arbitrary thresholds or additional unrelated edge cases.
Do not set final difficulty from this pre-trial review.
next_gate: Empirical difficulty/trajectory analysis after current Oracle/NOP/LLMaJ pass
